{{Top}}
{{Quote|I'm hit! My stabilizer's out!|Matchstick after his ship was damaged|<ref name="Shadow">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
A '''thruster stabilizer''' was a type of [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]] used on [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] were equipped with thruster stabilizers.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:MatchstickDeath-ShadowOfMalevolence.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Matchstick's engine explodes.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while attempting to pass through [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick's]] portside thruster stabilizer was damaged when his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] was hit by the wing of a [[Neebray/Legends|Neebray]]. When they were [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|attacked]] by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]],<ref name="Shadow" /> Matchstick's crippled [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]] exploded and the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] crashed into another [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] and was destroyed.<ref name="EpGuide" />
